source: Authored synthetic scenarios with fictional people and destinations, public technical terms, and reserved example.com/example.org domains. No production or personal user content.
purpose: Compare completion time and correction burden on matched synthetic finished-message tasks. This corpus contains tasks, not measured trials or proof of improvement.

instructions.typing: Type source_text and finish the message exactly as reference_text, including any manual repairs. Measure the complete task, not individual key callbacks.
instructions.dictation: Read source_text aloud, then finish the intended message as reference_text, including any manual repairs. Explicit self-corrections and spoken punctuation are part of the synthetic task. Include voice activation, processing and repair in elapsed time.

results_schema.participant: Use a pseudonymous identifier, never an email address or personal name.
results_schema.elapsed_seconds: Finite positive end-to-end task duration in seconds, supplied by the human benchmark.
results_schema.errors: Explicit nonnegative integer counts. Do not substitute zeros for missing observations.
results_schema.final_text: Optional CSV column, only for these synthetic tasks. If the column exists, an empty cell is scored as an empty output. Omit the column entirely to omit text scoring.
results_schema.task_modes: Use --mode typing or --mode dictation to filter observations. All-mode reports include separate by_mode groups and never combine modes into a paired percentage.
results_schema.manual_ratings: Optional user-consented manual ratings from 1 to 7: immediacy, comfort, annoyance and fatigue. Higher means more of that quality. Empty or absent cells are missing observations, never zeros; reports include only medians and observation counts.
results_schema.collection: The harness only reads an explicit offline CSV. It does not collect keyboard events, ordinary input, audio or network data.
